Word forms back to their base

Irregular and regular inflections

She went home early. They had gone before we arrived. The children's teachers taught us; the dog bit the postman and the women ran. The analyses abandoned older hypotheses, and the bigger cities grew happier.

Derivations

He smiled happily, then carelessly dropped the beautifully wrapped box. Her carelessness and unhappiness were obvious. The development of the decision surprised the teachers; their kindness was hopeless to repay.

Should stay unhighlighted

Business news: the corner shop hardly changed its letter, and the evening shower was during the morning meeting.
